name: @pipeworx/mcp-rick-and-morty

tools.name: search_characters
tools.description: Search Rick and Morty characters by name with optional filters for status (alive/dead/unknown), species (Human/Alien/etc.), and gender. Returns up to 20 matching characters per page with status, species, origin, current location, and episode appearances.

name.description: Character name to search for (partial match, e.g., "rick", "beth")

page.description: Page number (1-based, default 1). API returns 20 per page.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Get a single Rick and Morty character by numeric ID. Returns name, status, species, origin, current location, episode appearances, and image URL.

tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Search Rick and Morty episodes by name or episode code (S01E03 style). Returns episode metadata including air date, character list, and ID.

name.description: Episode name to search for (partial match).

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get a single Rick and Morty episode by numeric ID. Returns title, code (e.g. "S01E03"), air date, and the list of characters that appear.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Get a single Rick and Morty location/planet/dimension by ID. Returns name, type, dimension, and residents.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-rick-and-morty forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the rick-and-morty pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
